In practice

Preparing for your first flight

Training, technical checks and planning your work.

Know your equipment

Complete practical training for your model and read the manufacturer's manual. Learn the operating modes, warnings and procedures for stopping a flight before you begin.

Check the drone

Follow the manufacturer's checklist to inspect the frame, propellers, batteries and spraying system. Do not start a flight with faulty equipment or unresolved warnings.

Inspect the work site

Identify obstacles, power lines and areas where people may be present. Assess the weather and whether the work fits the manufacturer's limits and applicable requirements.

Plan the treatment

Choose the product and application rate with an agronomist and according to the product label. During training, check operating parameters against the manufacturer's instructions. This guide does not replace practical training.
